create_shared_chat_snapshot: create a shared chat snapshot for link sharing by calling SharedChats.create with chat_id and user_id
update_shared_chat_snapshot: update an existing shared chat snapshot with the latest chat state using SharedChats.update with share_id
get_shared_chat_by_id: get a shared chat by its share token using SharedChats.get_by_id with the share_id parameter
list_user_shared_chats: list all shared chats created by a user using SharedChats.get_by_user_id with optional filter skip and limit
delete_shared_chat: delete a shared chat by its share token using SharedChats.delete_by_id or delete_by_chat_id
